verdict.rationale: Rollbar's project-level Notifications fire real-time actions on errors and important events. These go to email, Slack, and incident tools, and can create, update, and resolve PagerDuty incidents. Webhooks push event data to any external service, and Custom Fingerprinting Rules auto-group incoming occurrences. Missing for 10: documented detail on configurable notification rule conditions and filters, automated in-product actions beyond notifications (e.g., auto-assign or auto-status rules), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
